messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning a rolling reboot + NIC rebind in az3 tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Affects meridian-4 and meridian-5 GPU pools. Target window 30m per rack, staggered. Need confirmation on backfill and canary order.

maria: Ack. I'll vet canaries and adjust autoscaler profiles. Which racks exactly?

alex: Racks r-az3-08..r-az3-12. We'll do r-08 -> r-09 -> r-10 etc. Full plan in the runbook: https://runbooks.internal/az3-nic-rebind (private).

sam: Heads up: meridian-5 has two big training tenants during that block. We should either move them off or shift window. Their peak ends ~16:30 UTC.

alex: Good catch. We can shift meridian-5 to start 16:45 UTC, meridian-4 stays at 15:00. Opinions?

jia: Prefer shift. Also note inter-region peering maintenance scheduled at 17:00 UTC, so avoid overlapping network churn.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: az3-nic-rebind - start 2026-03-23T15:00:00Z. Notifying oncall and tenants.

alex: @maria can you run a quick capacity check for both pools and post headroom numbers? Need to ensure reserved capacity + spot backfill covers canaries.

maria: Quick numbers: meridian-4 total GPU=160, reserved=60, avg-util=42%, headroom ~34 GPUs for canary. meridian-5 total GPU=200, reserved=80, avg-util=58%, headroom ~24 GPUs. These are after autoscaler dry-run.

sam: 24 GPUs for meridian-5 is tight if two tenants spike. We should either: 1) enable temp-burst from dedicated spare pool, or 2) ask tenants to throttle during their window. Temp-burst costs ~0.6x on top of normal.

jia: If we open temp-burst, we need SRE approval for cross-pool traffic. Also watch KV-cache cold-start on a move; expect a 200-400ms tail on first few requests.

alex: Let's do conservative approach: shift meridian-5 to 16:45, notify tenants to avoid heavy runs 16:30-17:15, and keep temp-burst as fallback. I'll draft tenant comms.

maria: I'll pre-seed KV cache for canaries after drain to reduce tail. Command I'll run: ```bash
kubectl drain gpu-node-r-az3-08 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# seed cache script
./tools/prime_kv_cache --pool meridian-4 --seq-len 64 --promote
```

sam: Add note: when we reattach NICs, watch for perf regressions on 64-token workloads — probe with the eval harness.

alex: On call: @oncall-bot please escalate if >3% error spike for 10m during the window. Also add temporary rate limiter to public hosted API routes for az3 in case of thrash.

oncall-bot: Escalation policy applied. Thresholds set.

jia: I'll coordinate with networking to ensure the peering flip at 17:00 doesn't overlap the tail of meridian-5. If needed we'll move peering by 30m.

alex: Final plan: meridian-4 start 15:00 UTC, meridian-5 start 16:45 UTC, 30m/rack stagger, pre-seed KV caches, temp-burst available as costly fallback, tenant notice sent. If anyone objects speak now, otherwise I'll post tenant comms in #customer-success and schedule the maintenance job. :thumbsup:
